vectors.description: a dialed session: DIAL intent before the SYN, DIAL outcome with the handshake overhead, HELLO and HELLO_ACK one CONTROL row per frame on each node, SESSION open on the listener (after HELLO), SESSION close with overhead
STATE_REQ and STATE: one CONTROL row per frame on both nodes
MANIFEST_REQ is a CONTROL row; MANIFEST is MANIFEST_SENT on the sender and MANIFEST_RECEIVED (the verdict in meshCode) on the receiver
a connection-level ERROR (ERROR:<code>) and GOAWAY (GOAWAY:<reason>) are CONTROL rows on both nodes
REVOKE_NOTICE is a REVOCATION row on the sender and on the receiver, in both directions
a pairing connection: SESSION open (pairing) on the listener, one PAIRING row per frame (all five kinds) on each node, both nodes group their rows into one session
an extension frame (type >= 0x80) from a non-conforming peer: CONTROL EXT_IGNORED on the receiver; the sender has no ledger here
every failed dial outcome has a DIAL intent (before the SYN) and a DIAL outcome (599); the other node has nothing: nothing was authenticated
inbound connections refused before authentication: ONE INBOUND_REFUSED row per window, with no address and no session
an attempt declined at the offer: the requester has intent and outcome (503 + code, offer and decline bytes summed); the lender has an OUTCOME ONLY

a served, streamed attempt: requester intent before the offer and outcome after the last frame; lender intent after the body arrives and outcome before INFER_END (whose bytes it already counts); bytes summed per direction
a cancelled attempt: CANCEL is counted in both outcome rows; the lender's code is CANCELLED
R3-CLOSURE-6: one session carrying two attempts: every row of both attempts (and the DIAL and SESSION rows) names the same session, so the rows group per session
a stack that cannot measure: every overhead figure is labelled ESTIMATED
FC-1: the requester's intent append fails: no byte of the attempt is sent, LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE, no further candidate; the session is closed cleanly afterwards
FC-4: the lender's intent append fails: it declines PEER_UNAVAILABLE, its own outcome row is the next write, the engine never starts (no lender intent row)
FC-5: the lender's outcome append fails: no INFER_END is sent, the session is closed (close:ledger-failure) and the requester records the loss

W01b-reach, L-L5 and L-L5b: the terminal row's egress is the reach (the furthest class that received CONTENT, local < peer < cloud), servedClass is the serving attempt's class, and the header equals the row; a declined offer does not raise reach
application bytes are 9 + payload: the worked encodings of LAB_SPEC 7.1 (HELLO with 7 payload bytes is 16, GOAWAY idle with 17 is 26, STATE_REQ with 7 is 16)
two connections one after the other: two sessions, and each node's rows group into two
an ERROR that carries an attemptId belongs to the attempt (no CONTROL row): the lender's outcome row carries its code, both outcome rows count its bytes
